title: 3:10 to Yuma
starring: Russell Crowe, Christian Bale, Ben Foster, Peter Fonda, Gretchen Mol
summary: In the American Old West, a struggling rancher volunteers to escort a captured outlaw to the 3:10 train bound for Yuma, where he will stand trial. As the outlaw's gang closes in, the two men develop a reluctant respect for one another during a dangerous journey.
